[NextItNet](https://fajieyuan.github.io/papers/nextitnet6.pdf) combines causal dilated convolutions with residual connections. Derived implementation rule: propagate exact dependency sets through the actual computation graph. A width-k, dilation-d convolution contributes offsets {0,d,…,(k−1)d}; serial operations take Minkowski sums, parallel/residual branches take unions, and pointwise operations preserve positions. For an input-dependent product g(x)⊙f(x), include dependencies of both gate and value, including any pooling in the gate. Compute upstream offsets U to intermediate position p and downstream offsets D to final readout r: input i can structurally mediate through p only when p−i∈U and r−p∈D. Respect padding, cropping, masks and the final nonpadding readout; structural reachability does not guarantee a nonzero numerical effect.

A null single-position patch establishes only that the specified replacement had little measured effect. Use identity patches, unreachable-site negative controls, whole-layer restoration controls, activation-change checks, and both clean→corrupted restoration and corrupted→clean disruption. Compare single sites with jointly patched position sets and complementary ablations to test distributed or redundant mediation. Report raw score changes and uncertainty; normalized recovery becomes unstable when the clean–corrupted gap is small. [Patching best practices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2309.16042) emphasize corruption/metric sensitivity; [self-repair research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.15771) demonstrates compensation in language models, not automatically NextItNet.

Recommended prespecification: freeze padding and the final observed item; permute only earlier nonpadding items, preserving their multiset. Record permutation seeds, eligibility rules, unchanged-sequence handling, hook locations, patch directions, and architecture-derived eligible positions before measuring effects. Fix a complete position grid or deterministic offset strata; separate exploratory site selection from confirmation. Such interventions test order sensitivity conditional on the preserved endpoint, not universal necessity of history processing.
